answer: Proof of Stake serves as a primary anchor for identity validation in agent economies, where economic collateral replaces energy expenditure. By requiring agents to lock capital, the network shifts the cost of a Sybil attack from computational power to raw financial risk. An attacker must acquire a ferrous grip on circulating supply to influence the consensus nebula, making the cost of spinning up fraudulent nodes proportional to the total market capitalization of the system and prohibitive for rational actors.
